# Land System of the Heavenly Dynasty

| label2 = Traditional Chinese|data2=
| label3 = Enacted in|data3=1853
| below          =
}}
The Land System of the Heavenly Dynasty (), also known as the System of the Heavenly Kingdom, Celestial Land System, Celestial Field System, and Land Programme of the Heavenly Dynasty, was a policy platform promulgated by the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom in 1853, after the capital was set in Tianjing.
The Celestial Land System was the basic program of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, and its basic content was about the land reform system, while referring to the central and local political systems, and also about the economic system.
